BONE
A colorful pigment created from natural materials that can be used to paint the cave wall or decorate meaningful objects.
Discard the bone and gain a Pigment Item card (search the Item card deck facedown for IT62). Record on the Recipes page of the
Journal that you have discovered white pigment.  You can now use a white-colored pencil when drawing on the cave wall.

Grinding this material won't produce anything useful.
Return the clay to your inventory.

Discard the cloudstone and gain a Pigment Item card (search the Item card deck facedown for IT62). Record on the Recipes page of
the Journal that you have discovered blue pigment. You can now use a blue-colored pencil when drawing on the cave wall.
CORAL (dead)
Grinding this material releases a burst of tiny fragments from inside the coral. The end result is a chalky, grey power.
Discard the coral and gain a Strange Powder Item card (search the Item card deck facedown for IT63).

ENDING EPOCH 1
The epoch of arrival draws to a close, and your people strive toward a future where they can thrive in the valley.
When you end the first epoch, resolve the following steps in order:
PERILS FORETOLD
Resolve any effects for Peril challenges that occur when that challenge is incomplete at the end of the epoch. Then return each looming
challenge to the game box.
FORGOTTEN PURSUITS

decisions past while planning for the future.

THE ICE WITHDRAWS
Over the centuries, the winters grow milder and the summers hotter. The ice withdraws to the most sheltered corners of the valley.

and place a glacier

other factors render even once-favorable sites less appealing, while natural disasters may drive your people from an area entirely.

.

you create, or to any other existing outposts from the first epoch.

restored to full functionality.

[p. 214]
A DVA N C E D R E G I O N R U L E S
MAELSTROM HILLS (REGION)
This section contains all the rules to add the Maelstrom Hills region to your valley.
MAELSTROM HILLS SETUP
When instructed to set up the Maelstrom Hills region, follow the steps below, in order:
Step 1:
Place a new terrain tray in the valley, adjacent to your hex, if able; otherwise, choose another hex in the valley with two or more open
edges, and place the new terrain tray adjacent to that hex. The tray must be placed such that its edges are adjacent to as many edges of
existing trays as possible. Then, place a second tray adjacent to the tray that was just placed, such that its edges are adjacent to as many
edges of the first tray as possible.
